_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for live squad state. Read by squad_state.py. TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md is the human narrative. Update BOTH after every actioned transfer.
as_at_note: GW1 pre-deadline. FULL REBUILD 12 Aug 2026 via optimise_squad.py (exact ILP, --fixtures --intel), 6 free transfers (unlimited pre-deadline, no hit cost): Mosquera/Van den Berg/Palmer/Schade/Verbruggen/Evanilson -> O'Reilly/Virgil/O.Dango/João Pedro/Leno/Sadiki. Run for the first time on the CORRECTED model: xbonus90 (roadmap A1, built 12 Aug) plus a fix excluding contaminated-prior players (Tier 1) that the greedy build never applied. Formation 3-5-2 -> 3-4-3. XI xP/90 (fixture-adjusted, with intel) 56.87, squad exactly £100.0m, bank £0.0m. See TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md for full reasoning including the trade-offs NOT hidden by this rebuild (Mosquera's minutes-opening thesis vs Virgil's fixture run; Palmer's individually elite score vs the budget it frees). Deadline Fri 21 Aug 2026 17:30 UTC. NOT yet actioned live on the FPL site - update squad.json/TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md is the record of the DECISION, not confirmation it has been submitted on fantasy.premierleague.com.

squad.name: Raya
squad.selected_on: 19 clean sheets, best xGC in the league (0.74). Unchanged since 9 Aug.

squad.name: Gabriel
squad.selected_on: xGC 0.72, 18 clean sheets, 23.7 bps/90, xbonus90 0.82 (3rd-highest DEF in the pool). Unchanged since 9 Aug.

squad.name: O'Reilly
squad.selected_on: xP_adj 4.67 with intel applied vs Mosquera's 4.28 (Mosquera's ROLE_INTEL boost included) - beats the intel-adjusted incumbent even before the ILP's budget reallocation is counted. 81% starts.

squad.name: Virgil
squad.selected_on: Liverpool's GW1-4 DEF x is 0.69, the best defensive fixture run in the league by a distance. 100% starts, xP_adj 4.48.

squad.name: B.Fernandes
squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.68, highest in the game. xbonus90 1.11, 2nd-highest in the pool. 100% starts. VICE (was captain).

squad.name: Mbeumo
squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.58, delta -3.0 - underperforming his chances. Unchanged since 9 Aug.

squad.name: O.Dango
squad.selected_on: xP_adj 5.23 with intel, 81% starts - the cheaper midfield route the ILP found once Palmer's £9.5m was reallocated across the whole squad.

squad.name: Sarr
squad.selected_on: flat xP 4.78 (before fixtures), delta -1.1 - only visible once gate 2 moved to a last-16 window. Unchanged since 9 Aug.

squad.name: Thiago
squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.62, 22 goals, 100% starts, xP_adj 5.26. CAPTAIN - highest E[pts] (5.15) and P(haul) (15.1%) of the squad's front-runners on captaincy_odds, 12 Aug.

squad.name: João Pedro
squad.selected_on: xbonus90 0.97 - 4th-highest in the ENTIRE 248-player pool, behind only Haaland, B.Fernandes and Ekitike. Delta +7.13 (one of the largest overperformances in the game) remains an open question the model doesn't resolve, but bonus gives him a second, largely independent route to points that isn't riding on his finishing holding up.

squad.name: Calvert-Lewin
squad.selected_on: 14 goals, xGI/90 0.55, delta -0.6 at £6.0m. Unchanged since 9 Aug.

squad.name: Leno
squad.selected_on: GK cover at £4.5m, 100% starts. Effectively tied with Verbruggen (xP_adj 3.36 vs 3.47) - the ILP's bench objective doesn't distinguish tied 100%-starters, so treat this as a coin-flip, not a finding.

squad.name: Justin
squad.selected_on: First substitute. 100% starts, xP_adj 3.64 - the most valuable autosub in the squad. Unchanged since 9 Aug.

squad.name: Shaw
squad.selected_on: Bench fodder - price and availability only. Unchanged since 9 Aug.

squad.name: Sadiki
squad.selected_on: Bench fodder, 100% starts. Replaces Evanilson (94% starts, xP_adj 3.91) - a real downgrade in autosub value the objective doesn't price (bench value/A0.6 is not yet built), accepted here because it freed budget for the João Pedro upgrade.

bought_for_note: Pre-season, purchase price equals current price. Keep bought_for accurate from GW1 - FPL pays purchase price plus half any rise on sale.

set1.expires_note: GW19 deadline. Chips in set 1 do NOT carry over.

set2.expires_note: Second set unlocks after the set-1 deadline.

selected_on_note: One line per player explaining WHY he is in the squad, mirroring TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md. Update alongside the log.
